FGA RATING SYSTEM — METRIC HIERARCHY EXPLAINED
FGA
FGA Rating Base ★ CORE METRIC
The primary Empire FGA score. Weighted average of all 38 Tier 1+2+3 metrics — your foundation of raw performance stripped of philosophy context. Sort by this to compare players purely on what they deliver on the pitch. Every other metric either feeds into or extends from FGA.
FGA = AVG(21 Tier-1 automated + 6 Tier-2 composite + 11 Tier-3 scout metrics)
Scale: 0–100  ·  25% weight in Ultimate
ULT
Ultimate FGA Rating
FGA elevated by context. Adds tactical philosophy fit, creative intelligence (CCI), clutch performance (CLU), harmonic style (HAR), and match pressure. A player can score higher on ULT than FGA if their philosophical DNA amplifies their base output — Messi's 9.08 ULT vs 8.74 FGA illustrates this perfectly.
ULT = (FGA×0.25)+(THI×0.15)+(CCI×0.15)+(CLU×0.10)+(HAR×0.10)+(MZ×0.20)+(CTX×0.05)
Scale: 0–100  ·  The definitive cross-league comparison tool
THI
Tactical Harmony Index
Measures how fluidly a player integrates across tactical systems. Positional intelligence, off-ball coordination, system adaptability. High THI means coachable and tactically evolved. Low THI means one-system specialist. Critical for clubs rebuilding under a new manager.
THI = tactical coordination composite (complex multi-factor)
Scale: 0–100  ·  15% weight in Ultimate
CCI
Creative Control Index
Creative game control — the ability to impose your will on a match through inventive decisions and unpredictability under pressure. Distinguishes technically correct players from genuinely creative ones. Scouts use this to identify players who change games, not just participate in them.
CCI = creative game control composite (advanced calculation)
Scale: 0–100  ·  15% weight in Ultimate
CLU
Clutch Factor
Performance gap between average and decisive moments. Goals in injury time. Assists in must-win matches. Clean sheets in finals. Measures what separates good professionals from players who win trophies. The rarest and most commercially valuable metric in the entire system.
CLU = decisive moment performance vs standard performance baseline
Scale: 0–100  ·  10% weight in Ultimate
HAR
Harmonic Style
The artistic dimension — spatial poetry, flow, elegant execution, individual flair. Captures what video scouts see that statistics miss. High HAR players are crowd favourites and manager's trusted weapons in tight matches. Encoded under LZ (Harmonic Style) in the 364-metric glossary.
HAR = complete artistic expression composite (LZ metric, column MZ)
Scale: 0–100  ·  10% weight in Ultimate
